Servers: prod-web-01 (degraded, 34.2%/61.8%/47.3%, us-east-1), prod-api-01 (degraded, 71.5%/83.2%/58.9%, us-east-1), staging-01 (degraded, 12.1%/38.4%/21.0%, eu-west-1), prod-worker-01 (offline, 88.3%/91.7%/72.1%, us-east-1).
